nest.text: In a hollow of warm sand, a giant scorpion lifts its tail. One sting and its poison will be in your blood.

fight.text: The scorpion circles you. Win before it stings you, and quickly: after three rounds it will tire of you and burrow away.

stung.text: The tail flicks past your guard. Fire runs up your arm and your legs go weak. You will live, but this journey is over.

gone.text: Three rounds, and the scorpion has had enough. It sinks into the sand and is gone. No trophy, but no sting either.

won.text: The scorpion lies still. You cut off its sting: a fine trophy for the city.

road.text: Beyond the dunes the road runs on to the city gates.
